positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
• Built Kinzoo App from scratch using clean architecture and multi-modules to be testable and easily scalable
• Implemented photo capturing and video recording using camera2 api for API 21 to the latest API
• Built JS-to-native bridge and integrate third party JS-based games, adding fun factors to the chat
• Implemented complex deep linking with autoVerify through out the app for smooth transition between apps
• Setup complete CircleCI jobs for pre/post merge and release builds which integrated with Slack notification for fast QA turnaround

positions.title: Mobile Developer, Software Engineering
positions.description:
• Re-architectured monolithic codebase to be modular and testable SDK 
• Built build-pipelines using Jenkins, Gradle, AppCenter, and Artifactory for both Android and iOS platforms for continuous deliveries
• Completed public API documentations and helped finishing integration guidelines for Customer Success Team

positions.title: Android Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Converted Astro-powered webviews to responsive native views for the better UI/UX
•	Architected cyclic state machine to easily manage view states and debug using RxJava
•	Integrated JaCoCo, unit/integrated testing and dex count reports with Jenkins pipeline using Gradle/Bash scripts

positions.title: Mobile Developer
positions.description:
•	Enforced MVP design pattern for the new REW lead management app
•	Utilized RxJava, Dagger2 and Retrofit libraries for the fast and reliable product development
•	Wrote Unit and UI tests using Espresso and Android Support Libraries to meet test coverage
•	Heavily focused in UI/UX design and animation using Google Material Design guideline
•	Implemented Fastlane and GitLab runners to achieve Continuous Delivery

positions.title: PSI Summer Co-op
positions.description:
•	Validating hundreds of multidisciplinary engineering tags from Major Projects for Asset Data Life-Cycle Project
•	Continuously supporting and coordinating with document controllers for InSitu Project Closeout
•	Undertaking electrical discipline MOCs for Suncor Co-op Presentation
•	Training existing Co-op students to support Asset Data Life-Cycle Project and Project Closeout for an efficient transition

positions.title: Engineering Co-op Student
positions.description:
•	Facilitating closing out multiple Legacy Projects
•	Coordinating with Cross-functional teams to support Project Closeout Initiative
•	Supporting the development of Project Closeout Model by creating a dynamic detailed project closeout log
•	Compiling Project Closeout Month End Stewardship Reports for various OPP areas
•	Generating active revisions, redline, project document reports to assist project closeout
•	Training and assisting any new personnel supporting Project Closeout Model
•	Reviewing over a thousand asbuilt drawings and utilizing AutoCad to improve the quality of asbuilt drawings
•	Creating and relaying Asset Master Data information to New Asset Integration team
•	Assisting Project Leads with creating and updating Project Execution Plan, Project Charters, and Gate Review Presentation

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description:
•	Tutored from kindergarten to Grade 12 mathematics
•	Formed special curriculum for high school diploma preparation
•	Analyzed students performances based on their skills and implements right style for them to learned better and faster

projects.title: Home Intelligence Awareness Platform
projects.description:
• Designed and programmed user interface using Java and XML
• Debugged and conducted software QA for a successful Home Intelligence Awareness Android app
• Coordinated between a client and capstone team of four students to identify the scope of work for
Home Intelligence Awareness Platform
• Tracked milestones, schedules, and budgets to ensure capstone project is on target
• Conducted a proposal presentation to demonstrate the feasibility of prototypes and to
recommend the optimal solution
• Received a highly positive performance review in project management by stakeholders and
instructor; received A grade

projects.title: Coin-operated Karaoke Machine
projects.description:
•	Designed a coin sorter, a change dispenser mechanism for a karaoke machine
•	Created prototypes of the mechanisms for simulation and verification
•	Experienced in planning, producing, debugging, and optimizing the mechanisms for the karaoke machine to run efficiently with high reliability and easy maintenances
